projects.title: Lumen Studio
projects.summary: Studio identity for a lighting atelier.
projects.story: A calm system that lets crafted objects breathe—balancing craft and clarity.
projects.description: Editorial rhythm, tactile surfaces, and a precise component language translated the brand into a calm digital storefront.

projects.title: Madhubani Series
projects.summary: Hand-painted panels inspired by folk symbolism.
projects.story: Exploring cultural motifs through a contemporary palette—stories painted in detail.
projects.description: A small series of paintings drawing from Madhubani line-work and iconography, reimagined for posters and prints.

projects.title: Atelier Archive
projects.story: Collected fragments—images and notes that trace a process, curated for slow reading.
projects.description: The experience foregrounded typography and carefully measured spacing to make long-form content feel inviting.

projects.title: Flow Collective
projects.summary: Spatial experiment for a small product team.
projects.story: Physical thinking translated into interface—materials and motion working together.
projects.description: A modular design language made it easy to ship new pages without losing the brand's careful tone.

projects.title: Northline Film
projects.summary: A photographic series for a short film campaign.
projects.story: Framed moments that support a larger emotional arc—light, texture, and timing.
projects.description: This project emphasized atmospheric color, bold crop-based imagery, and motion that supported the narrative arc.
